findingDetails.title: Python fallback hard-fails at import when the shared prompt-policy file is missing or malformed
findingDetails.scopeProof: module-level open of PROMPT_POLICY_PATH at skill_advisor.py:4078-4093 with no guard; sole consumer meaningful_token_count at :4106
findingDetails.case: A vendored or tampered install ships no runtime/data/prompt-policy.default.json, so the Python fallback exits with an import traceback instead of routing with its built-in predicates.
findingDetails.claim: The Python fallback gained an unguarded module-level file dependency, so a missing or malformed prompt-policy data file makes the entire fallback unimportable instead of degrading one predicate.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched for a guard, lazy load or fallback set around the read: none. Confirmed the TypeScript runtime already reads the same file, which narrows the absence path to tampering or an env override.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The data file ships with every packaged copy, so absence needs manual tampering, and a tampered env var is operator error.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Close as advisory if packaging is shown to emit runtime/data/prompt-policy.default.json for every install channel, including doctor-vendored and linked-worktree forms.
